verdict.rationale: Official store listings confirm both an iOS app and an Android app. The iOS listing details a broad feature set: Pro Search and Deep Research, Assistant, Labs, Voice, cited answers, Library, Discover and thread follow-ups. The Android listing describes a free app that syncs across devices and uses top AI models. missing for 10: a detailed Android feature list showing parity with iOS, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the mobile apps' quality.
